findings.highlight: A man who just got dumped
findings.evidenceJa: 一つの破局を迎えた男
findings.explanation: Takeya has just brought about a breakup by abandoning the woman at the hotel. The translation instead says that he was dumped, reversing who ended the relationship.
findings.japanese: たった今、一つの破局を迎えた男だった。
findings.todokanai: …A man who just got dumped.

findings.highlight: the truth that I would never have spoken of
findings.evidenceJa: 一番話さなくちゃならない事実
findings.explanation: Haruki calls this the fact he most has to discuss, despite it being hardest to raise. The translation turns that obligation into a categorical refusal or impossibility to speak.
findings.japanese:
かくして、一番話しづらくて、
そして、一番話さなくちゃならない事実は…
findings.todokanai: The truth I tried to hide, the truth that would be the most difficult to talk about, the truth that I would never have spoken of…

findings.highlight: "She's young and really successful, and has an insane work ethic."
findings.evidenceJa:
「若手の中じゃ出世頭で、
とにかくもの凄く仕事のできる人で」
findings.explanation: Haruki calls Mari the fastest-rising young employee and extraordinarily capable at her job; the English substitutes an 'insane work ethic,' changing proven professional ability into diligence.
findings.japanese:
「若手の中じゃ出世頭で、
とにかくもの凄く仕事のできる人で」
findings.todokanai: "She's young and really successful, and has an insane work ethic."

findings.highlight: I told him how I ended up being hurt
findings.evidenceJa: 傷つき、傷つけた俺
findings.explanation: Haruki explicitly says that at New Year he was hurt and hurt Mari. The translation preserves only his victimhood and deletes his admission that he harmed her.
findings.japanese:
クリスマスの時の甘え、癒された俺。
年明け早々の傷つき、傷つけた俺。
findings.todokanai: I told him how I was spoiled and healed during Christmas. I told him how I ended up being hurt as soon as the new year began.

findings.highlight: if the other person cheated too and you guys broke up
findings.evidenceJa: 向こうも浮気と割り切ってんなら
findings.explanation: Takeya says matters would be simpler if Mari too understood and compartmentalized their involvement as an affair. The translation invents Mari cheating and a breakup between Haruki and Mari.
findings.japanese:
「かぁ～！
またややこしいことに…
向こうも浮気と割り切ってんならまだ簡単だったのに」
findings.todokanai: "Agh…! You're being complicated again… It would've been so much simpler if the other person cheated too and you guys broke up…"

findings.highlight: the whole time I held her in my arms
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女を抱くその瞬間まで、いつだってそんな機会はあった
findings.explanation: Haruki says he had chances to confess at every point up until the moment he slept with Mari. The translation limits those chances to the time during which he held her, materially narrowing his prolonged culpability.
findings.japanese:
彼女を抱くその瞬間まで、
いつだってそんな機会はあったのに。
それでも俺は、話さなかったんだから。
findings.todokanai: I had the chance to say it the whole time I held her in my arms, and yet, I still did not say it.

findings.highlight: Rather than talking about the truth, I yearned for her instead.
findings.evidenceJa:
本当のことを話すよりも、
彼女を求めることを選んだんだから。
findings.explanation: Haruki says he chose to seek Mari rather than tell her the truth; 'I yearned for her' removes the culpable choice and concrete pursuit.
findings.japanese:
本当のことを話すよりも、
彼女を求めることを選んだんだから。
findings.todokanai: Rather than talking about the truth, I yearned for her instead.

findings.highlight: Don't give me that cliche sentence
findings.evidenceJa: そんな下世話なこと聞くな
findings.explanation: Haruki rebukes Takeya for asking a vulgar or prurient question. The translation calls the preceding speech a cliche sentence, losing both the question and Haruki's privacy boundary.
findings.japanese:
「そんな下世話なこと聞くな…
親友だからって、俺に非があるからって、
それでも言っていいことと悪いことがあるぞ」
findings.todokanai: "Don't give me that cliche sentence… Even though you are a good friend of mine and even though I'm in the wrong here, there are still things you should and shouldn't say."

findings.highlight: he told me that he has no hobbies outside of work
findings.evidenceJa: 仕事以外に趣味がないって嫌よねぇ
findings.explanation: Mari makes a self-directed, general lament that having no hobbies beyond work is awful. The translation fabricates a man who told her that he has no hobbies.
findings.japanese:
「そ、それは…暇だったし、他にやることなかったし。
あ～、仕事以外に趣味がないって嫌よねぇ」
findings.todokanai: "W-Well… I was free, and there was nothing left to do after all. Ah～ he told me that he has no hobbies outside of work, which sucks."

findings.highlight: my crucial error in judgement
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の決断『しなさ』
findings.explanation: Haruki condemns his deliberate failure or refusal to decide, with quotation marks stressing the absence of a decision. The translation turns nondecision into one mistaken judgment.
findings.japanese:
俺の弱さも、俺の選択も、
そして俺の決断『しなさ』も、
自分でさえ反吐が出る汚さに満ちていたから。
findings.todokanai: I myself feel nauseated over the disgusting things I've doneーmy weakness, my choices, and my crucial error in judgement.

findings.highlight: I can't bring myself to want Setsuna
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜を、どうしても自分から求められない
findings.explanation: Haruki says he cannot bring himself to reach for or pursue Setsuna, while he pursued Mari in a cruel way. The translation changes an inability to act on his attachment into an absence of desire for Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
雪菜を、どうしても自分から求められない。
麻理さんには、あんな酷い求め方をしてしまう。
findings.todokanai: No matter what, I can't bring myself to want Setsuna. But as for Mari-san, I end up wanting her, which itself is cruel to Setsuna.

findings.highlight: now just a part of my history
findings.evidenceJa: 一つの歴史のこと
findings.explanation: Haruki calls Touma Kazusa one history in his life. 'Now just a part' adds temporal closure and diminution even as the passage shows her memory still powerfully governing him.
findings.japanese: 冬馬かずさという、一つの歴史のことを。
findings.todokanai: Touma Kazusaーnow just a part of my history.

findings.highlight: She was an excellent student in some ways, and an extremely poor student in others
findings.evidenceJa: 片や超がつくほどの優等生。片や激がつくほどの劣等生
findings.explanation: The paired 'one...the other...' construction contrasts Mari, an exceptional model student, with Kazusa, an extreme poor student. The translation assigns both attributes to one woman.
findings.japanese:
片や超がつくほどの優等生。
片や激がつくほどの劣等生。
findings.todokanai: She was an excellent student in some ways, and an extremely poor student in others.

findings.highlight: She stood above the rest in some ways, though in turn, she always stuck with that aloof air of hers
findings.evidenceJa: 片や常に人の上に立ち、片や何があろうと孤高を貫く
findings.explanation: The source again contrasts Mari's habitual leadership with Kazusa's unwavering isolation. The translation fuses the two women into a single composite character.
findings.japanese:
片や常に人の上に立ち、
片や何があろうと孤高を貫く。
findings.todokanai: She stood above the rest in some ways, though in turn, she always stuck with that aloof air of hers all the time.

findings.highlight: She's far from being a perfect replica of her
findings.evidenceJa: 人間の完成度からして違う
findings.explanation: Haruki says the two women differ even in their degree of completeness or maturity as people. The translation replaces that evaluative difference with the unrelated idea that Mari is an imperfect replica of Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
人間の完成度からして違う、
まったく別個の女性であるはずなのに。
findings.todokanai: She's far from being a perfect replica of her, and she's a completely different woman.

findings.highlight: I'm falling back in love with her
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女に、のめり込ませていく
findings.explanation: Mari's resemblance pulls Haruki into his memories while making him fall ever deeper into Mari. 'Back in love' instead suggests renewed love for the remembered Kazusa and fabricates a prior love cycle for the immediate female referent.
findings.japanese:
否応なく俺を思い出の中に引きずり込む。
彼女に、のめり込ませていく。
findings.todokanai: I'm being pulled back into my memories whether I like it or not. I'm falling back in love with her.

findings.highlight: You used to always reject talking about her
findings.evidenceJa: そんなこと話してよく振られなかったな
findings.explanation: Takeya marvels that Haruki could tell Mari about Kazusa without Mari dumping him. The translation fabricates a history in which Haruki refused to talk about Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
「そいや一緒に冬馬の記事書いたんだっけ？
お前、そんなこと話してよく振られなかったな」
findings.todokanai: "Which reminds me, you two wrote an article on Touma, right? You used to always reject talking about her."

findings.highlight: topic of conversation would not improve even with snacks or alcohol
findings.evidenceJa: 話題が肴では、酒はちっとも進まず
findings.explanation: Haruki says his joyless, irresoluble story makes poor drinking accompaniment, so the alcohol does not go down. The translation instead says snacks and alcohol fail to improve the topic.
findings.japanese:
俺の、楽しくもなく前向きでもなく
解決もしない話題が肴では、酒はちっとも進まず…
findings.todokanai: My neither fun, nor forward-facing, nor resolute topic of conversation would not improve even with snacks or alcohol.

findings.highlight: we said we would redo everythingーa passionate lie that brought us to tears
findings.evidenceJa: あの、クリスマスイブの夜からやり直そうって、魂を込めた嘘の涙を流す
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines a future deception: shedding wholly committed false tears and proposing that he and Setsuna restart from Christmas Eve. The translation presents this as a past joint promise and shared tears.
findings.japanese:
あの、クリスマスイブの夜からやり直そうって、
魂を込めた嘘の涙を流す。
findings.todokanai: That night on Christmas Eve, we said we would redo everythingーa passionate lie that brought us to tears.

findings.highlight: I've not said anything since January arrived. After all, nothing has happened
findings.evidenceJa: ここ一月の間にあったことを何も話さず、全部、なかったことにして
findings.explanation: The imagined lie would conceal everything that happened during the past month and treat it all as though it never occurred. The translation misreads 'the past month' as January and asserts that nothing actually happened.
findings.japanese:
…ここ一月の間にあったことを何も話さず、
全部、なかったことにして。
findings.todokanai: …I've not said anything since January arrived. After all, nothing has happened.

findings.highlight: Didn't you say you understood when I said that I couldn't?
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にできるわけないってわかってて言ってるだろ
findings.explanation: Haruki asks whether Takeya suggested the lie while knowing Haruki could never carry it out. The translation invents an earlier exchange in which Takeya said he understood Haruki's statement.
findings.japanese: 「…俺にできるわけないってわかってて言ってるだろ？」
findings.todokanai: "…Didn't you say you understood when I said that I couldn't?"

findings.highlight: "close up small wounds," or to make her feel relieved
findings.evidenceJa: 『傷が浅くてすんだ』なんて胸をなで下ろせるほど
findings.explanation: Haruki says he is neither brazen nor untroubled enough to expose everything, decide cleanly, and then reassure himself that the wounds stayed shallow. The translation invents wound-closing and assigns the relief to Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
だからって、全てを白日の下に晒し、
はっきりと結論を出して、『傷が浅くてすんだ』なんて
胸をなで下ろせるほど厚顔でも平気でもない。
findings.todokanai: Even so, I don't have the audacity nor the courage to expose everything to the light of day, to properly come to a conclusion, to "close up small wounds," or to make her feel relieved.

findings.highlight: I won't tell Io about this, either
findings.evidenceJa: 依緒にも言わせない
findings.explanation: Takeya promises that if Haruki reaches a conclusion after suffering it through, he will no longer complain and will not let Io complain either. The translation instead promises to keep the matter secret from Io.
findings.japanese:
「苦しんで、のたうち回って…
それで出した結論なら、俺はもう文句言わない。
依緒にも言わせない」
findings.todokanai: "So you want to suffer and writhe in your own misery… and if you end up making a decision after that, I won't have any more complaints. I won't tell Io about this, either."

findings.highlight: the night where I became alone
findings.evidenceJa: 一つになった夜
findings.explanation: Haruki calls it the night when he and Mari became one. The translation renders this as the night he became alone, the direct opposite of the sexual and emotional union described.
findings.japanese: クリスマスの夜、過ちの夜、そして一つになった夜…
findings.todokanai: About that night on Christmas Eve, the night where I made that grave mistake, the night where I became alone…
